description: A skeleton warrior seen from the waist up, turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Its bones are pale with cyan highlights and brown shadows, and it wears a dented grey horned helmet tilted on its skull. Its bony hands grip a long straight sword whose blade glows icy cyan-white, held diagonally across the lower right. Behind its shoulder hangs a round dark blue shield with concentric rings, a short club crossed over it. The background is black. Light seems to come from the glowing blade, and the mood is grim and mocking. Frame 1: the jaw is closed and the head faces forward, held long. Frame 2: the head tilts and the jaw drops a little, a flash. Frame 3: the jaw opens wide, a flash. Frame 4: the jaw hangs fully open in a cackle, head tipped back, held. Frame 5: the jaw begins to close, a flash. Frame 6: the head tilts back toward the first pose, a flash. The loop reads as a long silent stare broken by a sudden, rattling laugh.
title: Laughing skeleton warrior with sword
